description: This file defines a class 'WorkExperience' used for handling display fields related to employee work experience in a reporting system of the OrangeHRM application. It extends a generic display field class and specifies methods to get associated DTO class, entity aliases, and relevant fields.

classes.name: WorkExperience
classes.description: A class representing display fields for work experience in reports, extending a listable display field base class.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the associated Data Transfer Object (DTO) for WorkExperience.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in query building for reports.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields relevant for the work experience display.
